Subject: Compliance add-ons: pricing, packaging, and 36-month commitment options

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m sending a concise breakdown of the compliance/security add-ons that Cardinal asked about and how we typically package them for enterprise customers. Attached: redwood_compliance_price_sheet_v2.pdf (pricing tiers + bundle).

Summary (high level):
- Audit logs: configurable retention tiers (30/365/Custom). Pricing guidance below. Can stream directly to your Splunk or bucket.
- KMS / HSM: two integration options — bring-your-own-KMS (no monthly HSM surcharge, you manage keys) or Redwood-managed HSM (one-time integration + monthly HSM fee).
- Data residency: per-region pinning (we run private deployment regions) — per-region surcharge applies.
- HIPAA / BAA: available at Enterprise tier; SOC 2 evidence provided during procurement.

Example list pricing (indicative):
- Audit logs: $0.03/GB/mo (standard). 36-month committed price: $0.01/GB/mo.
- KMS integration: $25,000 one-time integration (BYOK path available for $0 one-time but client-owned KMS billing applies). Managed HSM: $1,500/mo.
- Data residency: $2,000/mo per additional region.
- Compliance bundle (Audit logs + Managed HSM + Data residency + quarterly security review): list price = sum of parts; typical enterprise bundle discount 15–25% at 12–36 month commitments.

Two asks from us so we can get you a firm proposal:
1) Target commitment horizon (12/24/36 months) and approximate committed spend threshold.
2) Any hard constraints on data residency or on-prem requirements (e.g., must be in us-east-1 only).

I’ll loop in Aditya for the KMS/HSM technical specifics and Laura from legal for BAA/SOC2 details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_compliance_price_sheet_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifying items from our InfoSec and Procurement teams:

- Retention: We need a minimum 365-day audit-log retention and the ability to export/export on demand. Can your audit logs be exported to our S3 in us-east-1 and fed into Splunk?
- KMS/HSM: Cardinal prefers HSM-backed keys. Can you confirm the managed HSM option meets FIPS 140-2 Level 3, or will we need to provide our own HSM?
- HIPAA / BAA: We will require a signed BAA before any PHI is processed.
- Pricing / Discounting: Procurement has signaled they will push for a minimum 30% compliance add-on discount if we sign a 36-month commitment and commit to a minimum annual spend.

I’m attaching our security questionnaire (CH_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Can you provide an updated proposal that: (a) pins data residency to us-east-1, (b) includes HSM compliance details and (c) shows a 36-month committed pricing column with discounts applied?

Also include the SOC2 report and typical SLA for logs access. I’ll circulate to Jeff (procurement) for pricing negotiation.

Thanks,
Samantha

Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: pricing, packaging, and 36-month commitment options — technical + pricing details

Samantha / team —

Quick technical response to the asks and concrete numbers so you can feed Procurement:

Audit logs / export:
- We support streaming audit logs to customer S3 buckets in us-east-1 as an SQS/SNS-triggered push or direct S3 ingest. Splunk: we provide a forwarder spec and can support direct HTTP ingestion via a small connector.
- Retention: configurable per-tenant. Default tiers: 30 / 365 / custom. You can choose 365 as a policy and request on-demand export.

KMS / HSM options:
- BYOK (preferred by some customers): Redwood integrates with your cloud KMS (AWS KMS) and you retain key ownership. No Redwood HSM monthly fee; any egress/svc billing from your KMS remains on Cardinal. Minimal integration work (~1–2 weeks).
- Managed HSM (Redwood-managed, HSM-backed keys, FIPS 140-2 L3 compatible): $25,000 one-time integration + $1,500/month. We can provide FIPS attestation and vendor details in the SOC package.

Pricing (indicative, list):
- Audit logs: $0.03/GB/mo (list); 36-month committed tier: $0.01/GB/mo.
- Managed HSM: $25,000 one-time + $1,500/mo. BYOK: $0 integration fee (customer-managed).
- Data residency (per additional region pinned): $2,000/mo per region.

Discounting options:
- Compliance Add-on bundle (Audit logs + Managed HSM + Region pinning + quarterly review): list total ~ $X. We typically offer 15% off at 12-month commits, 20% at 24 months, and 25% at 36 months.
- For structured procurement: if Cardinal commits to > $1.2M ARR in Redwood spend across product + compliance add-ons we can (a) bump the 36-month bundle discount to 25–30% and (b) waive the one-time integration fee.

Deliverables we can include in the proposal: SOC 2 Type II summary, FIPS/HSM vendor attestations, BAA draft, and a sample log-forwarder implementation guide.

Happy to hop on a 30-min technical call with your InfoSec team to walk through the HSM options and prove the Splunk streaming.

—Aditya
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
